title: Spark: Sparklines in your shell
summary: Spark is a lightweight command-line utility that generates inline ASCII sparkline charts directly in the terminal, allowing users to visualize data trends without leaving their shell environment or needing external charting tools.
problem_solved: Quickly visualize data trends and patterns directly in the terminal without requiring full charting libraries or GUI tools.
why_valuable: It provides instant, frictionless data visualization that integrates seamlessly into existing shell workflows, making it ideal for monitoring, debugging, and quick data exploration.
